conversation_lines.text: And follow up with my doctors?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Exactly. Primary care in one week, eye doctor soon, and your transplant team for GVHD.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: I’ll do that. Thank you for taking such good care of me.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re very welcome. Take care, and call if anything changes.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: I will. Have a good day.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You too. The nurse will go over your discharge instructions now.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Okay, I’m ready.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: One last thing—we found a small cyst in your pancreas on the CT. It’s stable and likely benign, but your doctor may follow it up.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: I’ve had that for years. My last MRCP showed it was stable.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Good to know. We’ll make sure your records reflect that.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Thank you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your labs are improving. Hemoglobin is up, and white count is coming down.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: I’ve been anemic for a while. Is it from the diverticulitis?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Possibly, but also from chronic inflammation and your medical history. We’re not worried about active bleeding.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Okay. My leg has been aching too—right calf.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’re going to do an ultrasound to make sure it’s not a new blood clot, given your history.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: The leg ultrasound is back—no DVT. The pain is likely from your chronic issues, maybe restless legs or old fractures.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: That’s a relief. I get restless legs at night. I’m on ropinirole.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll keep that going. Your mirtazapine may also help with sleep and nerve pain.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re doing really well. You’re eating regular food, pain is mild, and labs are stable.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Can I go home soon?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Yes, likely tomorrow. We’ll write your discharge orders today.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: What about my eye drops? I need special ones for my left eye.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Some are not on our formulary. We’ll ask your family to bring them from home. And we’ll discuss surgery options with your eye doctor soon.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Thank you. And my pancreatic cyst? Was it mentioned?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Yes, it’s unchanged—2.4 cm, likely benign. You should follow up with an MRCP or EUS in six months.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re cleared to go home today. You’re tolerating food, walking well, and pain is controlled.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Great. What do I need to do at home?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Finish all your antibiotics and vancomycin. Stay on a low-fiber diet for a few more weeks. Take your regular meds, including rivaroxaban.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: And follow up with my doctors?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Yes—GI, hematology, eye, and pain management. We’ll send records to them.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Thank you, Dr. Lee. I feel much better.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re welcome. Call if pain worsens, you develop fever, or have trouble breathing. Take care.
